ops.title: baseSha in the graphite submit is gt's recorded parent_branch_revision, by reference — do not "fix" it to a live parent head
ops.body:
`gtSubmitPlan` in internal/cli/shipgt.go fills each entry's `baseSha` from `state[name].Parents[0].SHA`, which `internal/gtmeta` reads out of gt's own metadata: the `parent_branch_revision` the branch was last tracked or restacked against. That is a RECORDED revision, not the parent's live head, and it can lag the parent ref. To a reviewer it looks like the classic stale-base bug, and the obvious "fix" is to resolve the parent ref live, or to add a remote-reachability check on the sha before submitting.

Do not. Correctness here is by reference to gt, not by reasoning about which sha "should" be the base. gt's entry source, verbatim from graphite-cli 1.7.20:

```
getSubmissionInfo=({branchName:e,context:t})=>{const n=assertBranchIsValidAndNotTrunkAndGetMeta({branchName:e,context:t});return{head:e,headSha:n.branchRevision,base:n.parentBranchName,baseSha:n.parentBranchRevision}}
```

`baseSha: n.parentBranchRevision` is the identical recorded field. And it works on the wire: on 2026-09-02 gt 1.8.6 created four PRs off non-trunk bases (PRs #17357-#17360) sending the same recorded `parent_branch_revision` ccx had sent for those very branches, and got 200 each time.

Why it is not wrong: the recorded revision is the parent head the child's commits were last replayed onto, and a restack writes it back (0.56.0's git-replay restack does this too, as gt does). So it names the base the child's diff was actually computed against. A live parent head that has moved past it describes a base the child has not been restacked onto yet, and the ship already refuses a stack gt reads as off its parent before any submit runs.

History: when ccx's multi-branch submit 400'd (2026-09-02), a stale `baseSha` was the first suspect. The gt capture above killed it. The real cause was batching every branch into one `prs[]` array; see the sibling note "Graphite submit contract: gt posts ONE prs entry per call and loops".

Anchors: `gtSubmitPlan`, `gtSubmitPRs` in internal/cli/shipgt.go; `SubmitPR.BaseSha` in internal/gtapi/routes.go.
